rationale: MXL shows extreme intraday volatility — a range from $58.44 to $66.16 today on top of yesterday's massive $8+ range — making stop placement very difficult relative to the ATR of $1.57 and the wide 78.6 bps spread. Despite a positive earnings beat, the stock gapped down and is trading well below yesterday's close, suggesting the news catalyst has already been absorbed with a bearish reaction; the price is currently in the middle of a choppy range with no clear directional momentum in the last 5 candles. With 4 working long orders already committed and a semiconductor sector under pressure (SPY -0.41%, VIXY +2.99%), adding correlated long exposure here carries unfavorable risk/reward, and the spread cost alone eats significantly into any short-term edge.
